n1.speaker: arthur
n1.text: Hello again! You look puzzled. Is that a brown envelope? They're never good news!

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! گیج به نظر میاید. اون پاکت قهوه‌ایه؟ هیچ‌وقت خبر خوبی نیستن!

branches.suggestion: It's from HMRC. I don't understand all of it.
branches.suggestionFa: از HMRC ـه. همه‌ش را نمی‌فهمم.

branches.suggestion: Could you help me read this letter?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونید کمکم کنید این نامه را بخونم؟

cultureNote.en: HMRC is the UK tax office. Official letters often come in brown envelopes, hence the joke.

n2.speaker: arthur
n2.text: Let me see. "Regarding your tax return…" — that just means "about your tax return".

translations.fa: بذارید ببینم. «Regarding your tax return…» — یعنی فقط «دربارهٔ اظهارنامهٔ مالیاتیتون».

branches.suggestion: And what does "in order to" mean here?
branches.suggestionFa: و اینجا «in order to» یعنی چی؟

n3.speaker: arthur
n3.text: "In order to process your claim, please complete the enclosed form." So — they need you to fill in the form that's inside the envelope.

translations.fa: «برای رسیدگی به درخواستتون، لطفاً فرم پیوست را تکمیل کنید.» پس — لازمه فرمی که تو پاکته را پر کنید.

branches.suggestion: Oh, so "enclosed" means it's in the envelope.
branches.suggestionFa: آه، پس enclosed یعنی تو پاکته.

n4.speaker: arthur
n4.text: "No later than the thirty-first of January." That's the deadline — after that there's a fine.

translations.fa: «حداکثر تا سی و یکم ژانویه.» این مهلته — بعدش جریمه داره.

branches.suggestion: I'll do it this weekend then.
branches.suggestionFa: پس این آخر هفته انجامش می‌دم.

cultureNote.en: 31 January is the UK deadline for online Self Assessment tax returns. Late returns get a £100 penalty.

n5.speaker: arthur
n5.text: A hundred pounds, I think, so don't leave it! And "should you require assistance" just means "if you need help".

translations.fa: فکر کنم صد پوند، پس عقب نندازید! و «should you require assistance» یعنی فقط «اگه کمک لازم دارید».

branches.suggestion: Why don't they just say that?
Thank you, Arthur. That's much clearer now.

n6.speaker: arthur
n6.text: Ha! That, my friend, is the great mystery of British paperwork. Good luck!

translations.fa: ها! این، دوست من، راز بزرگ کاغذبازی بریتانیاییه. موفق باشید!
